pr_title: Let API create and edit system webhooks
pr_body:
"System" webhooks -- webhooks run on all repos on a Gitea instance -- were added in https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/14537 but managing them by the API is buggy:

- `PATCH /api/v1/admin/hooks/:id` edits either kind (?)
- `DELETE /api/v1/admin/hooks/:id` deletes either kind

but

- `POST /api/v1/admin/hooks/` creates "default" webhooks
- `GET /api/v1/admin/hooks/` and `GET/api/v1/admin/hooks/:id` return "system" webhooks

To fix the confusion:

- In routers/api/v1/utils/hook.go, correctly handle the distinction between system and default webhooks. This allows actually creating, editing and deleting both kinds.
- In routers/api/, split `/api/v1/admin/hooks` to `/api/v1/admin/hooks/{system,default}`.
- In routers/web/, move `/admin/{system,default}-hooks` and most of `/admin/hooks/` into `/admin/hooks/{system,default}` to match API.
- In model/, normalize vocabulary. Since the new sub-type, the terminology has been a confusing mix of "SystemWebhook", "DefaultSystemWebhook", "SystemOrDefaultWebhook" and "DefaultWebhook". Standardize on "AdminWebhook" everywhere with a `isSystemWebhook bool` parameter to separate the two sub-types.
    - Using a bool made it easier to handle both cases without duplicating the router endpoints. I hope that's okay.
- Make `PATCH /admin/hooks/{system,default}/:id` return 404 instead of 500 when appropriate to do so.

Fixes https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/23139.

Supersedes https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/23142.
pr_comments: I see that there's a lot of other issues competing for attention in https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/milestone/148. Is there anything I can do to make it easier to review?   I'm hoping to help get this in before the [original bug](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/23139) hits its first birthday :cake:

Maybe we can use `/admin/hooks` as global hooks but `/admin/hooks/{configType}` as default hooks?
Is that compatible with before? Otherwise, we need a breaking change. For API breaking change, we need to do more things.

> Hi @lunny,
> 
> My team would like to have this issue fixed so that it is possible to set up Gitea in an automated way. Is there a good chance to get it merged if we find a way to fix it in a manner that keeps the current API and has some additional API to define the default hook type? Or would you prefer to have a breaking change that also removes the old behavior, like this one? What additional work needs to be done, and how can I (or someone from my scrum team) help fix this bug?
> 
> @kousu is this issue still relevant for you?

I would like to continue the review if it can resolve the API-breaking problem. If the breaking is necessary, we at least need to add deprecated for several versions until we remove it.

Yes I would like to still see this for the same reason as @philipparndt. But the code has drifted very far now and I suspect it needs a full rewrite, especially if the purpose of the surrounding APIs may have changed.  I won't be offended if you close this and submit a replacement.
All right, I have planned to implement this and let you know when it is ready.

Hi @lunny & @kousu,
Do you have any objections to moving the configType to an optional query parameter (system/default/any)?
This way we should be able to configure the default value on the various endpoints to match the old inconsistent behaviour avoiding a breaking change while also allowing api users to explicitly configure which kind of hook they want to interact with.
It's probably not the prettiest solution but maybe an appropriate tradeoff.
Not the prettiest no, but I think if it gets things going then it's good 🌠

Hi @lunny & @kousu,

After reading the source I think I found a simple and compatible way to fix the issue.
I've opened another PR for it at #33180.
I hope that enables us to finally resolve this topic.

issue_context.title: System Hooks API confused with Default Hooks API
issue_context.body:
### Description

`GET /admin/hooks` lists hooks with `is_system_webhook = true`, but `POST /admin/hooks` creates them without. There does not currently seem to be a way to create a system webhook from the API -- only default webhooks; meanwhile there is no way to list default webhooks from the API.

I see that `/admin/hooks` was only added less than a month ago with https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/14537. It's an niche but extremely helpful feature for what I'm trying to do with Gitea, so I want to help get it working.

### Gitea Version

1.19.0+dev-586-g10cdcb9ea

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

No -- but only because I don't have admin rights there

### Log Gist

https://gist.github.com/kousu/1f0be0c81dce500caef0b0af3e985196

### Screenshots

Under http://localhost:3000/admin/hooks I start with an empty slate

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-27-23 Gitea Git with a cup of tea](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342335-57e748eb-d3bf-4cc9-8c16-af913b787096.png)

I go to http://localhost:3000/api/swagger and log in:

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-26-31 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342314-64bad90c-22d5-47de-b75c-cb4543fe7e22.png)


http://localhost:3000/api/swagger#/admin/adminGetHook gives an empty list

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-30-46 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342465-92869bd1-ad8f-4c9e-a8cf-66e988293cdf.png)


I create a hook:

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-30-26 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342469-3fae3540-046e-41cb-b641-a220fb256c7f.png)

Back on the *UI* at http://localhost:3000/admin/hooks I can see it, but it's a Default Hook:

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-31-25 Gitea Git with a cup of tea](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342488-796ccac2-86a8-4411-a275-8cf9d1781c59.png)

But using the API gets me an empty list still:

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-32-07 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342517-709e86c7-962a-4774-bd20-8fd53bbfa866.png)

If I make a system webhook *with the UI*

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-33-16 Gitea Git with a cup of tea](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342544-c5cf9c56-9f03-46bc-aa5a-83bdec57c584.png)

it adds to the UI

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-33-31 Gitea Git with a cup of tea](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342556-8b3e6e2e-d1f9-488f-a978-bd8e883cc68d.png)

and the API can see it:

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-33-59 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342578-c0c99f88-6dd5-4c2a-82db-a5d25782f02f.png)

If I add another Default Webhook

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-34-33 Gitea Git with a cup of tea](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342611-71bd1f65-8633-46d6-8846-2232039d1902.png)

The API **cannot** see it

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-34-58 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342633-6d1de6d8-5b02-4d56-a8bc-dd6e674e11ca.png)

...unless I specifically ask for hook 20

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-35-44 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342682-d24cde0a-7a6d-4de7-97dd-7d804f4e2b65.png)

19 also works, but there's nothing to distinguish that it is a system hook:

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 01-36-12 Gitea API](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221342683-c52541dd-c05d-44e3-a8e3-5727a8acf81e.png)


### Git Version

2.34.1

### Operating System

Ubuntu 22.04

### How are you running Gitea?

```
user@dev:~/src/gitea$ TAGS="bindata sqlite sqlite_unlock_notify" make build
user@dev:~/src/gitea$ ./gitea
```

### Database

SQLite

CreateHook calls

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/10cdcb9ea8077098921d72720f9f36fcfd950452/routers/api/v1/admin/hooks.go#L112

"AddSystemHook", which sounds like it should add a system hook

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/10cdcb9ea8077098921d72720f9f36fcfd950452/routers/api/v1/utils/hook.go#L71-L82

but the object it creates is here

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/10cdcb9ea8077098921d72720f9f36fcfd950452/routers/api/v1/utils/hook.go#L137-L171

which leaves `IsSystemWebhook` nil.

The only place in the code that's set to `true` is in the code that handles the UI:

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/10cdcb9ea8077098921d72720f9f36fcfd950452/routers/web/repo/webhook.go#L98-L105

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/10cdcb9ea8077098921d72720f9f36fcfd950452/routers/web/repo/webhook.go#L229-L241
Also there's no way to set a hook secret with the API, which makes it unusable (unless your hooks all disable signature verification).

Also there's no way to set `events = {"push_only":true}` with the API; with the UI, the default is

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 03-31-01 Gitea Git with a cup of tea](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221347401-aa4fbe8f-07dc-45dd-81fc-f6138da317c8.png)

but with the API you always get

![Screenshot 2023-02-25 at 03-31-09 Gitea Git with a cup of tea](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/987487/221347402-7764c9a3-375d-4d2d-9a45-ebd11ad0d949.png)

I ran into this. Thanks for working on it.
FWIW the push_only / custom thing is also reported at https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/20178

Any idea how far this is from being complete?

I think this can be closed as of https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/33180

`GET /admin/hooks` does now have a parameter `type`

```yaml
- type: string
  enum:
    - system
    - default
    - all
  description: system, default or both kinds of webhooks
  name: type
  default: system
  in: query
```

review_comments: This is the core change. Almost everything else is fall-out from making this one line change.

In https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/23142#discussion_r1185678106, lunny suggested what I added as `/api/v1/admin/hooks/default`, but also wanted to keep the old behaviour too.

Respectfully, I think we must not. The old behaviour was inconsistent:

* GET /hooks -> return system hooks (because it [calls `GetSystemWebhooks`](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/26418/files?diff=split&w=0#diff-22d0aa89fecea5f42f8b5b8bee1deff88580051e9723b162fa37810b1a9b708fL40))
* POST /hooks -> create a default hook (because [`isSystemWebhook` is missing therefore false](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/26418/files?diff=split&w=0#diff-98b5cce3b814ddf612db812011c9192de3abcbbc6022dd39fa6d0fd02dc8ca25R188)).

For "backwards compatibility", we could chose to keep the `POST /hooks` == `POST /hooks/default`, but then we would have to break `GET /hooks`; we could choose to keep `GET /hooks` == `GET /hooks/system`, but then we would have to break `POST /hooks`.

The confused behaviour was in the [original version of `/api/v1/admin/hooks`](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/14537/), so I doubt anyone is using it in the wild -- I was probably the first person to try and immediately hit this bug. Anyone else who tried would have hit it too.
This line is what communicates the one line change above into the backend.
This is what adds the correct 404 to the PATCH method.
I think this is a break change and with no deprecated mark?
